name: Barnaloppan
tagline: Listings, prices and sales for your Barnaloppan booth
description: Manage your booth at Barnaloppan, the second-hand children’s market. Add listings, update prices and photos, and track sales and payouts. You can also hide sold items from the list.
examples: What were my booth’s total sales this week?
Lower the price of the winter overalls to 3,000 kr.
Hide the listings that have sold.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List booth listings with price, tag status, hidden and sold flags

tools.name: get_sales
tools.description: Sales rows and payout totals (sold, commission, balance)

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Show the stored session and optionally check it is live

tools.name: add_products
tools.description: Create listings with optional local photos

tools.name: set_product_images
tools.description: Replace photos on existing listings by ID

tools.name: unprint_products
tools.description: Mark price tags unprinted so name/price can be edited

tools.name: edit_products
tools.description: Change name and/or price of listings by ID

tools.name: show_products
tools.description: Put hidden listings back in search

envVars.name: BARNALOPPAN_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Login password for auth login (never stored)

envVars.name: BARNALOPPAN_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose MCP write tools

is.tagline: Vörur, verð og sala í básnum þínum í Barnaloppunni
is.description: Haltu utan um básinn þinn í Barnaloppunni. Skráðu vörur, breyttu verði og myndum og fylgstu með sölu og útborgunum. Þú getur líka falið seldar vörur af listanum.
examples: Hvað hef ég selt fyrir mikið í básnum í vikunni?
Lækkaðu verðið á vetrargallanum í 3.000 kr.
